rows.quote: If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.
rows.reason_zh: 戾影附身至持续时间结束并存活时，仍会刷新该技能的冷却。

rows.quote: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
rows.reason_zh: 目标获得技能免疫会使戾影脱落，技能本身没有赋予减益免疫的效果。

rows.quote: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
rows.reason_zh: 目标进入隐身是戾影脱落的条件，戾影本身不会使单位隐身。

rows.quote: Once latched, the phantom damages and silences.
rows.reason_zh: 戾影附身后仍会沉默目标。

rows.quote: destroy_attacks: [6,6,9,9]→[2,2,3,3]
rows.reason_zh: 摧毁戾影所需的攻击次数发生调整，它仍属于召唤物定义排除的按受击次数计算的单位。

rows.quote: Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍指定一个敌方目标，由戾影追向该目标并附身。

new_mechanisms.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the phantom.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42明确规定小兵和幻象对戾影只造成25%的伤害，减伤仅适用于戾影受到的这两类来源的伤害。

rows.quote: Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍能持续伤害友方目标周围的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 装备魔晶后，施放墨涌时仍会对友方目标施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time.
rows.reason_zh: 持续伤害以携带墨涌的友方单位为中心，作用于其周围的敌人，符合光环定义。

rows.quote: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍提高友方目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍使墨涌按其造成的伤害治疗友方目标。

rows.quote: it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit
rows.reason_zh: 墨涌仍会在友方目标周围造成范围眩晕。

rows.quote: removes most negative effects from the caster. Radius: %replenish_radius% Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 主动技能仍会对施放者自身施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: Passive: Guardian Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units. Radius: %aura_radius%
rows.reason_zh: 守护光环仍为范围内的友方单位提供生命和法力回复。

rows.quote: bonus_movement: 50→55
rows.reason_zh: 装备提供的移动速度加成从50提高到55。

rows.quote: Restores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies
rows.reason_zh: 主动技能仍能为附近友军恢复生命值。

rows.quote: Guardian Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units.
rows.reason_zh: 低血量时的额外生命回复已删除，常规光环仍提供生命回复。

rows.quote: Restores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies
rows.reason_zh: 主动技能仍有范围法力回复效果。

rows.quote: %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units
rows.reason_zh: 守护光环仍提供持续法力回复。

rows.quote: Roots all enemies in the target area for %duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 主动技能仍会缠绕目标区域内的所有敌人。

rows.quote: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击或技能造成伤害是触发加速的条件，加力燃烧器自身没有范围伤害效果。

rows.quote: Break disables the gaining of new stacks. Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
rows.reason_zh: 新注释明确破坏会阻止获得新层数并保留已有加成，但材料未给出该词条指定的 IsBreakable 字段值。

rows.quote: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.
rows.reason_zh: 矮人直升机攻击或施法伤害敌人后仍会短暂提高自身移速。

rows.quote: aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area
rows.reason_zh: 飞弹仍会伤害目标区域内的多个敌人，作用半径由400增至425。

rows.quote: aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area
rows.reason_zh: 飞弹仍会减速目标区域内的敌人。

rows.quote: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 作用半径缩小后，每次强化攻击仍能命中范围内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: The additional attacks can proc attack modifiers at reduced effectiveness, except for Lifesteal and Critical Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 7.42使额外攻击可以按降低的效能触发攻击特效，因此原先的否定判断已失效。

rows.quote: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 一次攻击仍可波及周围所有敌方单位，符合给定的分裂溅射定义。

rows.quote: The additional attacks can proc attack modifiers at reduced effectiveness, except for Lifesteal and Critical Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 额外攻击可触发的效果明确排除了暴击，技能本身也没有赋予暴击。

rows.quote: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍使一枚导弹持续向范围内发射火箭弹幕，追踪目标具有优先级。

rows.quote: The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 导弹能追击并命中已经隐身的单位，技能本身没有赋予隐身的效果。

rows.quote: dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target
rows.reason_zh: 导弹撞击目标时仍会造成眩晕。

rows.quote: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍直接指定一个敌方单位作为追踪目标。

new_mechanisms.quote: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the missile.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42新增了针对小兵和幻象的减伤说明，这两类来源对导弹只造成25%的伤害。

rows.quote: Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
rows.reason_zh: 侧翼机枪每次在射程内优先选取最远的单位攻击，新增攻击效能数值没有赋予单次攻击范围伤害。

rows.quote: attack_effectiveness: null→75
rows.reason_zh: 唯一的字段变化是攻击效能，材料未给出核实可被破坏所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
rows.reason_zh: 近战双击的第一击仍附带移动减速，符合攻击特效定义。

rows.quote: pulls you and the target closer together
rows.reason_zh: 对敌人使用鱼叉时仍会把目标拉向使用者。

rows.quote: bonus_mana_regen: 2→2.5
rows.reason_zh: 装备提供的法力回复从2提高到2.5。

rows.quote: Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.
rows.reason_zh: 使用者可以主动指定一棵树，将自身拉到树旁。

rows.quote: The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
rows.reason_zh: 近战双击的第一击仍会降低敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.
rows.reason_zh: 说明给出了拉向树木的位移终点，未说明使用者移动时能穿过树木和悬崖。

rows.quote: Passive: Regeneration Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied player units. Radius: %aura_radius%
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍提供回复光环，7.42将受益对象明确为范围内的友方玩家单位。

rows.quote: Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied player units.
rows.reason_zh: 恢复头巾仍为友方玩家单位提供生命回复。

rows.quote: Active: Disarm Prevents a target from attacking for %disarm_melee% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 缴械持续时间从3.5秒缩短至3秒，期间仍阻止目标攻击。

rows.quote: bonus_evasion: 25→null
rows.reason_zh: 7.42删除了装备的闪避加成。

rows.quote: bonus_health_regen: 6.5→4.5
rows.reason_zh: 装备的生命回复降至4.5，仍有正值加成。

rows.quote: Grants the caster %bounty_pct%%% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep.
rows.reason_zh: 施放者在支配野怪时即可获得其部分金钱和经验赏金。

rows.quote: If a new unit is dominated, the old one will die.
rows.reason_zh: 旧单位死亡由支配新单位触发，技能没有按目标生命阈值斩杀的效果。

rows.quote: +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen
rows.reason_zh: 头盔仍为被支配单位提供额外生命回复。

rows.quote: Takes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit
rows.reason_zh: 装备能夺取一个非远古中立单位的控制权，符合给定的召唤物定义。

rows.quote: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
rows.reason_zh: 头盔也能夺取敌方线上小兵和召唤单位的控制权。

rows.quote: Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep.
rows.reason_zh: 施放者在支配野怪时即可获得该野怪的金钱和经验赏金。

rows.quote: it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise
rows.reason_zh: 说明赋予被支配单位抵御特定即死技能的效果，头盔本身没有按生命阈值斩杀目标的效果。

rows.quote: +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen
rows.reason_zh: 头盔仍提高被支配单位的生命回复。

rows.quote: Takes control of one neutral target unit
rows.reason_zh: 装备仍可夺取一个中立目标单位的控制权，符合给定的召唤物定义。

rows.quote: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方线上小兵和召唤单位也仍可被头盔支配。

rows.quote: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area. Affected enemies take damage over time
rows.reason_zh: 同一张网仍能持续伤害区域内靠近树木的多个敌人。

rows.quote: are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area
rows.reason_zh: 被网住的敌人仍会被拉向目标区域内离各自最近的树。

rows.quote: have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun
rows.reason_zh: 受影响敌人的视野在眩晕期间仍会降为0。

rows.quote: stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area
rows.reason_zh: 眩晕时间有所缩短，范围内靠近树木的敌人仍会被眩晕。

rows.quote: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
rows.reason_zh: 摧毁树木是解除眩晕的方法，技能本身没有砍树效果。

rows.quote: The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies
rows.reason_zh: 一次投掷仍能伤害旋镖沿途穿过或命中的多个敌人。

rows.quote: more vulnerable to spell damage
rows.reason_zh: 易伤限定于技能伤害，未赋予针对物理伤害或全部伤害的加深效果。

rows.quote: spell_amp: 20→15
rows.reason_zh: 敌方目标受到的技能伤害加成从20%降至15%，技能易伤仍然存在。

rows.quote: causes affected enemies to be slowed
rows.reason_zh: 旋镖施加的减益仍会降低受影响敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage
rows.reason_zh: 数值修饰的是敌方目标承受的技能伤害，技能没有给施法者提供法术放大。

rows.quote: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只给出旋镖的飞行和命中方式，无法确认施放时能否直接选择敌方单位。
行为字段发生变化，但材料未给出核实可被破坏所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
rows.reason_zh: 转移概率虽降至10%，敌方攻击仍有概率转向树木而未命中森海飞霞。

rows.quote: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.
rows.reason_zh: 承受转移攻击的树木仍会被摧毁。

rows.quote: evasion_multiplier: 2→1
rows.reason_zh: 攻击转移概率的倍率降为1，密林奔走自身不再提高躲过攻击的概率。
基础技能在各级仍提供正值移速加成。

rows.quote: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍会短暂赋予森海飞霞相位移动。

rows.quote: tree-walking for a brief time
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍让森海飞霞在短时间内穿过树木。

rows.quote: dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能命中敌方英雄时仍会施加破坏。

rows.quote: The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 蓄力时间决定伤害和减益时长，说明没有按次消耗的充能点数。

rows.quote: Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot.
rows.reason_zh: 发射弩箭产生的后坐力仍会使森海飞霞向后位移。

rows.quote: dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能命中敌方英雄时仍会减速。

rows.quote: Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot.
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认了后坐位移，未说明该位移能穿过树木或越过不可通行地形。

rows.quote: Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确指出推送不会打断目标的动作，原先对打断持续施法的否定判断成立。

rows.quote: Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other
rows.reason_zh: 对敌方目标使用时仍会把对方推离使用者。

rows.quote: Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
rows.reason_zh: 使用者仍可对自己施放，沿自身朝向主动位移。

rows.quote: push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing
rows.reason_zh: 说明只给出推送的方向和距离，未说明目标能在推送中穿过树木或悬崖。
